run_crawl_camera_specs: run the script with --lib_path to crawl digicamdb.com and generate C++ camera sensor spec files
run_request_trial: run a function with up to 10 retry attempts on failure using request_trial
run_parse_args: run parse_args to get the required --lib_path CLI argument for the camera specs crawler
review_main: review the main function that scrapes camera makes, models, and sensor widths from digicamdb.com
refactor_request_trial: refactor request_trial to add configurable retry count or specific exception handling
